title: The oriented open segment with multiplicity one is an IMRep
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, a, τ ∈ ℝ^P with |τ| = 1, and ℓ > 0. There is an integer multiplicity triple R (structure IMRep of the frozen contract, Simon 6.3.1) of degree 1 in U = ℝ^P such that: (i) R.carrier ⊆ [a, a + ℓτ] (segment ℝ a (a + ℓ • τ)); (ii) R.measure(ℝ^P) < ∞; (iii) R.action(ω) = ∫_{(0,ℓ)} ω(a + uτ)(τ) du for every differential 1-form ω on ℝ^P, where ω(y)(τ) is the value of the 1-covector ω(y) on the 1-tuple (τ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a τ : Euclid P) (ℓ : ℝ), ‖τ‖ = 1 → 0 < ℓ → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.carrier ⊆ segment ℝ a (a + ℓ • τ) ∧ R.measure univ < ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1, R.action ω = ∫ u in Ioo 0 ℓ, ω (a + u • τ) (fun _ => τ)
